Computational Thinking

Start here Coming soon

The starting point. Students learn to break problems into parts, recognize patterns, focus on what matters, and describe solutions as clear steps.

Find it on the map

Activity ideas

Unplugged ideas for each topic, to be written up as full activities.

  • Break It Down · Decomposition

    Groups split a big job, such as running a school event, into smaller and smaller tasks on sticky notes, building a task tree on the wall.

  • Guess My Rule · Pattern recognition

    One student secretly picks a rule for sorting picture cards; the class tests cards to discover it.

  • Map Maker · Abstraction

    Students draw a map of the school for a new student, then compare which details each map kept and which it dropped, as a transit map does.

  • Human Robot · Algorithmic thinking

    Partners write exact steps for a task such as folding a paper airplane; a classmate follows them literally, and the class sees where the steps fell short.

Activities

Full activities for this region are being written. Each will be unplugged, with a teacher guide and print-ready handouts, and students will need no technology.
